messages:
maddie: FYI saw a deploybot pin during quant-v4b rollout eu-west. Kernel incompat ratio jumped and p95 climbed. did the new sentinel intend to pin for this model?

jon: which numbers? the sentinel was supposed to only pin longseq/dialog classes.

maddie: deploybot logged kernel_incompat=0.41, p95+32% for ~80s. it pinned runtime 2.14.1 for 1h.

deploybot: [automated] pinned runtime 2.14.1 -> reason: compat-sentinel(kernel_incompat=0.41,p95_delta=32%).

kevin: looks like the model-class guard rollbackged out last sprint. i'll patch to reintroduce model_class gating and add an sdk-version AND for tokenization mismatches.

jon: instead of immediate pin for non-longseq, can we route to stable-pool for 5m and keep monitoring? avoids churn.

ops: stable-pool routing is cheap to enable for canary runs. ops will prep capacity and add pin-unwind steps.

kevin: note: tokenization-mismatch signal should only affect pins when client SDK >= 2.7. we saw noise from a staging job still on 2.6.

maddie: suggested follow-ups: re-add model_class guard (jon), add sdk guard (kevin), implement stable-pool reroute (ops), short changelog note (maddie).

jon: opening PR for rule change with unit tests. target canary 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

kevin: adding feature-flag gated SDK check and will coordinate rollout.

deploybot: [automated] created rollout-note "sentinel-model-class-guard" PR #8420 by jon. canary run scheduled.

ops: will hang temporary mute for customer notifications during canary and add alert for pin-churn > 3/30m.

sre-bot: [automated] created INC-2026-1203 for pin-churn alert config.

maddie: canary completed, stable-pool reroute handled the spike, no further pins. closing but leaving followup card for telemetry granularity. :thumbsup:
